claims.summary: For the d=3 colon curve C=V((F,m1):k) over F_p, p=32003 or 65521, assuming the recorded plane avoids the non-irrelevant associated primes of (F,m1,k) and retaining the recorded modular ideal/section dimensions, h1(I_C(55))>=35 and h1(I_C(56))>=58. Thus its Rao module is not concentrated in one degree, excluding the one-degree hypothesis of Migliore-Nagel Theorem 5.2 in these conditional modular controls. No characteristic-zero conclusion follows. Identification with the original threshold scheme requires the additional recorded modular colon-equality hypothesis.
claims.assessment: Conditional consequence of the two existing modular computations, not a new computational run. The restriction cokernel injects into the preceding ideal-sheaf cohomology; differences 73-(60-22) and 131-(133-60) are 35 and 58. The plane and modular-identification qualifications of the original entries remain.
claims.rationale: Rules out a concrete non-ACM replacement for the queued Gaeta mechanism on the retained controls; it changes the next research action but gives no improved first-step bound or novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Develop the next queued mechanism for the residual speciality index; retain the separate characteristic-zero lifting question.

conj:cube-first-step-arithmetically-cm.assessment: Conjecture in characteristic zero. The rational resolution proves d=2. Later d=3 modular colon comparisons at 32003 and 65521 give conditional non-ACM controls under the recorded plane assumption (and for the threshold ideal, the modular colon-identification hypothesis). Upper semicontinuity does not transfer this failure to characteristic zero; that question remains open and queued.

conj:cube-first-step-arithmetically-cm.mathematical_status: Retained conjecture status; the latest colon-section and second-prime records do not prove a characteristic-zero refutation.
conj:cube-first-step-arithmetically-cm.significance: Still a stronger lifting mechanism, now with conditional modular counterevidence; no threshold improvement is claimed.
